typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		IBX as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		{Name (Local)} as string,
		{Can Enter IBX} as string,
		{Can Remove Equipment} as string,
		{Can Bring Registered Guests} as string,
		{Can Be a Certified Tour Guide} as string,
		{Can Activate BCTR} as string,
		{Enrollment Status} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		FirstName as string,
		CanActivateBCTR as string,
		FName as string,
		NameLocal as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		EnrollmentStatus as string,
		CanRemoveEquipment as string,
		CanBringRegisteredGuests as string,
		LastName as string,
		CanEnterIBX as string,
		IBX as string,
		CanBeACertifiedTourGuide as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		FirstName = {First Name},
		CanActivateBCTR = {Can Activate BCTR},
		FName,
		NameLocal = {Name (Local)},
		EtlUser,
		EnrollmentStatus = {Enrollment Status},
		CanRemoveEquipment = {Can Remove Equipment},
		CanBringRegisteredGuests = {Can Bring Registered Guests},
		LastName = {Last Name},
		CanEnterIBX = {Can Enter IBX},
		IBX,
		CanBeACertifiedTourGuide = {Can Be a Certified Tour Guide}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
